This is the beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
The first words of the good news of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
神的兒子，耶穌基督福音的起頭。
As it is written in Isaiah the prophet: “Behold, I will send My messenger ahead of You, who will prepare Your way.”
Even as it is said in the book of Isaiah the prophet, See, I send my servant before your face, who will make ready your way;
正如先知以賽亞（有古卷沒有以賽亞三個字）書上記著說：看哪，我要差遣我的使者在你前面，預備道路。
“A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for Him.’”
The voice of one crying in the waste land, Make ready the way of the Lord, make his roads straight;
在曠野有人聲喊著說：預備主的道，修直他的路。
John the Baptist appeared in the wilderness, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.
John came, and gave baptism in the waste land, preaching baptism as a sign of forgiveness of sin for those whose hearts were changed.
照這話，約翰來了，在曠野施洗，傳悔改的洗禮，使罪得赦。
People went out to him from all of Jerusalem and the countryside of Judea. Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.
And there went out to him all the people of Judaea, and all those of Jerusalem, and they were given baptism by him in the river Jordan, saying that they were sinners.
猶太全地和耶路撒冷的人都出去到約翰那裡，承認他們的罪，在約旦河裡受他的洗。
John was clothed in camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.
And John was clothed in camel's hair, with a leather band about him; and his food was locusts and honey.
約翰穿駱駝毛的衣服，腰束皮帶，吃的是蝗蟲、野蜜。
And he began to proclaim: “After me will come One more powerful than I, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and untie.
And he said to them all, There is one coming after me who is greater than I, whose shoes I am not good enough to undo.
他傳道說：「有一位在我以後來的，能力比我更大，我就是彎腰給他解鞋帶也是不配的。
I baptize you with water, but He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit.”
I have given you baptism with water, but he will give you baptism with the Holy Spirit.
我是用水給你們施洗，他卻要用聖靈給你們施洗。」
In those days Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee and was baptized by John in the Jordan.
And it came about in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was given baptism by John in the Jordan.
那時，耶穌從加利利的拿撒勒來，在約旦河裡受了約翰的洗。
As soon as Jesus came up out of the water, He saw the heavens breaking open and the Spirit descending on Him like a dove.
And straight away, coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens broken open and the Spirit coming down on him as a dove:
他從水裡一上來，就看見天裂開了，聖靈彷彿鴿子，降在他身上。
And a voice came from heaven: “You are My beloved Son; in You I am well pleased.”
And a voice came out of heaven, You are my dearly loved Son, with whom I am well pleased.
又有聲音從天上來，說：「你是我的愛子，我喜悅你。」
At once the Spirit drove Jesus into the wilderness,
And straight away the Spirit sent him out into the waste land.
聖靈就把耶穌催到曠野裡去。
and He was there for forty days, being tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals, and the angels ministered to Him.
And he was in the waste land for forty days, being tested by Satan; and he was with the beasts; and the angels took care of him.
他在曠野四十天，受撒但的試探，並與野獸同在一處，且有天使來伺候他。
After the arrest of John, Jesus went into Galilee and proclaimed the gospel of God.
Now after John had been put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the good news of God,
約翰下監以後，耶穌來到加利利，宣傳神的福音，
“The time is fulfilled,” He said, “and the kingdom of God is near. Repent and believe in the gospel!”
And saying, The time has come, and the kingdom of God is near: let your hearts be turned from sin and have faith in the good news.
說：「日期滿了，神的國近了。你們當悔改，信福音！」
As Jesus was walking beside the Sea of Galilee, He saw Simon and his brother Andrew. They were casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.
And going by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon, and Andrew, the brother of Simon, putting a net into the sea: for they were fishermen.
耶穌順著加利利的海邊走，看見西門和西門的兄弟安得烈在海裡撒網；他們本是打魚的。
“Come, follow Me,” Jesus said, “and I will make you fishers of men.”
And Jesus said to them, Come after me, and I will make you fishers of men.
耶穌對他們說：「來跟從我，我要叫你們得人如得魚一樣。」
And at once they left their nets and followed Him.
And they went straight from their nets, and came after him.
他們就立刻捨了網，跟從了他。
Going on a little farther, He saw James son of Zebedee and his brother John. They were in a boat, mending their nets.
And going on a little farther, he saw James, the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who were in their boat stitching up their nets.
耶穌稍往前走，又見西庇太的兒子雅各和雅各的兄弟約翰在船上補網。
Immediately Jesus called them, and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired men and followed Him.
And he said, Come after me: and they went away from their father Zebedee, who was in the boat with the servants, and came after him.
耶穌隨即招呼他們，他們就把父親西庇太和雇工人留在船上，跟從耶穌去了。
Then Jesus and His companions went to Capernaum, and right away Jesus entered the synagogue on the Sabbath and began to teach.
And they came to Capernaum; and on the Sabbath he went into the Synagogue and gave teaching.
到了迦百農，耶穌就在安息日進了會堂教訓人。
The people were astonished at His teaching, because He taught as one who had authority, and not as the scribes.
And they were full of wonder at his teaching, because he gave it as one having authority, and not like the scribes.
眾人很希奇他的教訓；因為他教訓他們，正像有權柄的人，不像文士。
Suddenly a man with an unclean spirit cried out in the synagogue:
And there was in their Synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he gave a cry,
在會堂裡，有一個人被污鬼附著。他喊叫說：
“What do You want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have You come to destroy us? I know who You are—the Holy One of God!”
Saying, What have we to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth? have you come to put an end to us? I see well who you are, the Holy One of God.
「拿撒勒人耶穌，我們與你有甚麼相干？你來滅我們嗎？我知道你是誰，乃是神的聖者。」
But Jesus rebuked the spirit. “Be silent!” He said. “Come out of him!”
And Jesus said to him sharply, Be quiet, and come out of him.
耶穌責備他說：「不要作聲！從這人身上出來吧。」
At this, the unclean spirit threw the man into convulsions and came out with a loud shriek.
And the unclean spirit, shaking him violently, and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.
污鬼叫那人抽了一陣瘋，大聲喊叫，就出來了。
All the people were amazed and began to ask one another, “What is this? A new teaching with authority! He commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey Him!”

And they were all greatly surprised, so that they put questions to one another, saying, What is this? a new teaching! with authority he gives orders even to the unclean spirits, and they do what he says.
眾人都驚訝，以致彼此對問說：「這是甚麼事？是個新道理啊！他用權柄吩咐污鬼，連污鬼也聽從了他。」
And the news about Jesus spread quickly through the whole region of Galilee.
And news of him went out quickly everywhere into all parts of Galilee round about.
耶穌的名聲就傳遍了加利利的四方。
As soon as Jesus and His companions had left the synagogue, they went with James and John to the home of Simon and Andrew.
And when they came out of the Synagogue, they went into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
他們一出會堂，就同著雅各、約翰，進了西門和安得烈的家。
Simon’s mother-in-law was sick in bed with a fever, and they promptly told Jesus about her.
Now Simon's wife's mother was ill, with a burning heat; and they gave him word of her:
西門的岳母正害熱病躺著，就有人告訴耶穌。
So He went to her, took her by the hand, and helped her up. The fever left her, and she began to serve them.
And he came and took her by the hand, lifting her up; and she became well, and took care of their needs.
耶穌進前拉著她的手，扶她起來，熱就退了，她就服事他們。
That evening, after sunset, people brought to Jesus all who were sick and demon-possessed,
And in the evening, at sundown, they took to him all who were diseased, and those who had evil spirits.
天晚日落的時候，有人帶著一切害病的，和被鬼附的，來到耶穌跟前。
and the whole town gathered at the door.
And all the town had come together at the door.
合城的人都聚集在門前。
And He healed many who were ill with various diseases and drove out many demons. But He would not allow the demons to speak, because they knew who He was.
And a number, who were ill with different diseases, he made well, and sent out evil spirits; but he did not let the evil spirits say anything, because they had knowledge of him.
耶穌治好了許多害各樣病的人，又趕出許多鬼，不許鬼說話，因為鬼認識他。
Early in the morning, while it was still dark, Jesus got up and slipped out to a solitary place to pray.
And in the morning, a long time before daylight, he got up and went out to a quiet place, and there he gave himself up to prayer.
次日早晨，天未亮的時候，耶穌起來，到曠野地方去，在那裡禱告。
Simon and his companions went to look for Him,
And Simon and those who were with him came after him.
西門和同伴追了他去，
and when they found Him, they said, “Everyone is looking for You!”
And when they came up with him, they said to him, Everyone is looking for you.
遇見了就對他說：「眾人都找你。」
But Jesus answered, “Let us go on to the neighboring towns so I can preach there as well, for that is why I have come.”
And he said to them, Let us go to other parts into the nearest towns, so that I may give teaching there, because for this purpose I came.
耶穌對他們說：「我們可以往別處去，到鄰近的鄉村，我也好在那裡傳道，因為我是為這事出來的。」
So He went throughout Galilee, preaching in their synagogues and driving out demons.
And he went into their Synagogues in every part of Galilee, preaching and driving out evil spirits.
於是在加利利全地，進了會堂，傳道，趕鬼。
Then a leper came to Jesus, begging on his knees: “If You are willing, You can make me clean.”
And a leper came to him and, going down on his knees before him, made a request, saying, If it is your pleasure, you have the power to make me clean.
有一個長大痲瘋的來求耶穌，向他跪下，說：「你若肯，必能叫我潔淨了。」
Moved with compassion, Jesus reached out His hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” He said. “Be clean!”
And being moved with pity, he put out his hand, and touching him said to him, It is my pleasure; be made clean.
耶穌動了慈心，就伸手摸他，說：「我肯，你潔淨了吧！」
And immediately the leprosy left him, and the man was cleansed.
And straight away the disease went from him, and he was made clean.
大痲瘋即時離開他，他就潔淨了。
Jesus promptly sent him away with a stern warning:
And he sent him away, saying to him very sharply,
耶穌嚴嚴地囑咐他，就打發他走，
“See that you don’t tell anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and present the offering Moses prescribed for your cleansing, as a testimony to them.”
See that you say nothing to any man: but go and let the priest see you, and make yourself clean by an offering of the things ordered by Moses, for a witness to them.
對他說：「你要謹慎，甚麼話都不可告訴人，只要去把身體給祭司察看，又因為你潔淨了，獻上摩西所吩咐的禮物，對眾人作證據。」

But the man went out and openly began to proclaim and spread the news. Consequently, Jesus could no longer enter a town in plain view, but He stayed out in solitary places. Yet people came to Him from every quarter.

But he went out, and made it public, giving an account of it everywhere, so that Jesus was no longer able to go openly into a town, but was outside in the waste land; and they came to him from every part.
那人出去，倒說許多的話，把這件事傳揚開了，叫耶穌以後不得再明明地進城，只好在外邊曠野地方。人從各處都就了他來。
